title: pilosella glomerata subsp. calomelana
intro: Pilosella glomerata subsp. calomelana, commonly known as the Sickle-Headed Hawkweed or Hawk's Beard, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its distinctive yellow flowers and growth habit. This plant is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella glomerata subsp. calomelana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and vulnerary properties, making it useful in treating minor cuts and scrapes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
